semantic_cases.title: Stage 2 Guidance Gate: Two Distinct Examples Required
semantic_cases.description: Manual candidate draft created with 0 examples attempts publication; fails with KNOWLEDGE_INSUFFICIENT_EXAMPLES. Candidate with 2 distinct verified examples publishes successfully with hud_status = not_configured.
preconditions: Candidate B has 2 distinct observed-complete demonstrations.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Candidate A rejected; Candidate B published with hud_status = not_configured and valid PlaybookVersionV1.

semantic_cases.title: Decision Table Exact Boundary vs. Overlap Detection
semantic_cases.description: Table with Row 1 amount <= 10000 USD and Row 2 amount > 10000 USD passes UNIQUE validation. Changing Row 2 to amount >= 10000 USD fails with KNOWLEDGE_RULE_OVERLAP due to overlap at exactly 10000 USD.
preconditions: Table formalization has input invoice_amount of type money USD.
actions: Validate table with <= 10000 and > 10000 -> verdict pass.
Validate table with <= 10000 and >= 10000 -> verdict overlap at counterexample 10000.00 USD.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Disjoint table approved; overlapping table rejected with KNOWLEDGE_RULE_OVERLAP.

semantic_cases.title: Three-Valued Fact Evaluation Halts on Currency Mismatch
semantic_cases.description: Rule requires USD currency fact. Evaluation receives EUR currency fact. Evaluator yields Unknown, resulting in disposition blocked rather than arbitrary decision.
preconditions: Active rule specifies invoice_amount with currency USD.
actions: Evaluate rule with input fact amount 500.00 EUR.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: RuleEvaluationV1 returns result unknown and disposition blocked.

semantic_cases.title: Transactional Guard Serialization During Rule Change Race
semantic_cases.description: Agent manifest registration races concurrent rule activation. Monotonic generation guard ensures registration either precedes activation and is recorded, or sees new restriction.
preconditions: Compliance admin approves new rule version R2 activating generation G2.
actions: Register M1 concurrently with R2 approval.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: No race allows M1 to operate under obsolete rule without eligibility restriction or revalidation queue entry.

semantic_cases.title: Source Withdrawal Linearization vs. Publication
semantic_cases.description: If source contribution withdrawal commits before publication, publication fails with KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE_INELIGIBLE. If publication commits first, published playbook transitions to needs_revalidation with partially_unavailable evidence.
preconditions: Staged candidate depends on contribution C1.
actions: Withdraw C1 while publishing staged candidate.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Withdrawal first blocks publication; publication first preserves playbook with revalidation warning.

semantic_cases.title: Rejection of Overlapping Guidance Default Scopes
semantic_cases.description: Attempting to register two default playbooks with overlapping audience and application profile scopes fails with KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE_OVERLAP.
preconditions: Playbook 1 is default for team_finance and app_erp_core.
actions: Set Playbook 2 as default for team_finance and app_erp_core during overlapping interval.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Registration rejected with KNOWLEDGE_SCOPE_OVERLAP; system never falls back to newest timestamp heuristic.

semantic_cases.title: Handoff Idempotency, Amendment, and Summary Privacy
semantic_cases.description: Replaying exact handoff intake proposal returns original handoff. Higher revision creates linked amendment without mutating accepted work. Recipient team sees authorized summary with redacted source workflow details.
preconditions: Proposal P1 ingested as handoff H1.
actions: Replay P1 revision 1 -> 200 OK idempotent H1.
Submit P1 revision 2 -> 201 Created linked amendment.
Recipient team queries H1 -> Source workflow redacted.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Idempotent replay verified, accepted work protected from silent mutation, recipient summary isolated.

semantic_cases.title: Recursive CTE Traversal Budget Enforcement
semantic_cases.description: Interactive graph query traversing deep dependency graph exceeding depth 8 or 2-second timeout returns partial page with degraded_reasons.
preconditions: Graph has deep dependency chain of depth 15.
actions: Execute interactive query with max depth 8.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Query returns 200 OK with completeness = partial and degraded_reasons = ['depth_limit_exceeded'].

semantic_cases.title: Search Fallback to Lexical When Embedding Model Offline
semantic_cases.description: When LiteLLM embedding gateway is unconfigured or budget-blocked, search query succeeds using full-text tsvector GIN index with degraded indicator.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Returns lexical matches with degraded_reasons = ['semantic_search_unavailable']; never fabricates semantic ranking.

semantic_cases.title: Previous-Policy Continuation Exact Interval and Revocation
semantic_cases.description: Continuation grant permits named agent to operate under superseded rule until not_after. Upon reaching not_after, eligibility status immediately transitions to restricted.
preconditions: Continuation granted for Agent A under old rule until 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z.
semantic_cases.expected_observable_result: Agent restricted immediately upon expiration without requiring worker intervention.
